ITEM 1 | Pale white, opaque, crumbly/fluffy mass with irregular rough-edged clumps and small curds, dry-looking surface with no sheen, covering the upper-left portion of a white square plate (roughly 40% of plate area), about 2 cm average piece height, sitting directly on the plate and partly touching the orange cubes below | 190

ITEM 2 | Diced orange cubes, about 1.5 to 2.5 cm pieces, with slightly caramelized, darker orange edges and some browning, glossy-looking surfaces, firm and holding shape, clustered in the lower-center of the plate (roughly 20% of plate area), mixed with darker brownish-purple cube pieces | 110

ITEM 3 | Darker brown-purple cubes, about 2 cm, with matte, slightly browned surfaces, firm and holding shape, mixed among the orange cubes in the lower-center of the plate, covering about 6% of plate area | 45

ITEM 4 | Orange carrot-like sticks/pieces, sliced into rounds or chunks about 1.5 cm, bright orange with slightly glossy, moist surfaces, sitting on a separate white plate at the far left edge of the image, partially visible and cut off by the frame | 80
